verifyNotes: Confirm item count, time, fee, passing score, domains, weights and any exam-guide update against the official AWS exam page and exam guide. Use current service names and features. Questions are long scenario-based architecture trade-offs: the keyed answer must be the one that best meets every stated requirement (cost, operational overhead, availability, RTO/RPO, security). Never copy official sample questions.
name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
audience: Solutions architects with 2+ years designing and deploying cloud architecture on AWS
format: 75 items (65 scored, 10 unscored) in 180 minutes; multiple choice and multiple response; scaled score 100–1000, pass 750.

domains.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
skills: Architect network connectivity: Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, VPN, VPC peering, PrivateLink, Route 53 Resolver, IPv4/IPv6 planning
Prescribe security controls across accounts: IAM Identity Center, SCPs/RCPs, permission boundaries, KMS, Secrets Manager, Security Hub, GuardDuty
Design reliable, resilient architectures: multi-AZ/multi-Region, RTO/RPO, DR strategies (backup-restore, pilot light, warm standby, active-active)
Design multi-account environments with AWS Organizations and Control Tower; cost visibility and chargeback

domains.name: Design for New Solutions
skills: Design deployment strategies: CloudFormation, CDK, CI/CD, blue/green and canary
Design for business continuity and reliability
Determine security controls for new workloads
Design for performance and cost: compute, storage, database and caching choices; serverless vs containers vs EC2; purchasing options

domains.name: Continuous Improvement for Existing Solutions
skills: Improve operational excellence: observability, automation, incident response
Improve security posture and remediate findings
Improve performance, reliability and cost of running workloads; right-sizing, Savings Plans, storage tiering

domains.name: Accelerate Workload Migration and Modernization
skills: Select workloads and migration strategies (7 Rs); discovery and planning tools (Migration Hub, Application Discovery Service)
Choose migration tooling: Application Migration Service, DMS/SCT, DataSync, Snow Family, Transfer Family
Determine new architectures for modernisation: containers, serverless, purpose-built databases, decoupling with SQS/SNS/EventBridge
